summary.text: A 1959 Executive Board resolution (in Russian) that takes note of the Director-General's preliminary review of BCG vaccination programmes and asks for a further report on internationally assisted mass BCG campaigns at the next session.
The front-matter heading of a Russian-language Executive Board resolution, giving only the name of the World Health Organization.
